rules_primary: If the team with the last pick of the draft selects any Wide Receiver with their last pick in the 2026 Pro Football Draft, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
The market resolves based on the last player selected in the 2026 Pro Football Draft, regardless of which team makes that selection.

If the player's position differs across source agencies, the position used by The Governing League will be used to determine settlement.
title: Will the team with the last pick of the draft select a Wide Receiver with the last pick?
